chapters.title: Chapter 1451: A Mission
paragraphs: Kent spent many seconds admiring the stunning beauty who asked him the question. To better answer her, he needed to see the kind of beast she is.
She sat upon a throne carved from darkwood, one that seemed more jade-like than normal wood. Obviously, that was a clear indication that it was not simple wood.
Long silver hair cascaded down her back like a waterfall of moonlight, each strand gleaming with beauty. Her eyes were a piercing shade of emerald green.

Her high cheekbones and flawless pale skin made her even more stunning. Of course, from what Kent knew, when Spirit Beasts finally take on their humanoid form, they can later change it as they see fit.
However, it takes years to accomplish all that. Seeing her flawless skin, he knew she had spent a great deal of time achieving such a look.
One thing her appearance also pointed out was how she viewed humans.
To be able to shape her looks like that, she must be familiar with humans or, in this case, Elves, considering she had a long elven ear.
This means she is more familiar with humans than a beast living in such a place should be.
Two slender, curved horns, smooth and obsidian-black, rose gracefully from her temples. She wore flowing robes of deep forest green embroidered with golden runes.
This appearance, coupled with the fact that Kent just couldn’t see a single opening in her defence, told him all he needed to know. Messing with her is not an option.
"First of all, it was self-defence. Second, if you ask how I got here, the answer is that the teleportation talisman I used malfunctioned, sending me here. I didn’t come on my own accord."
She showed no sign of hatred, but her gaze remained locked on him.
"You could have injured them and run off. I saw how fast you were moving and knew you had the speed advantage, so why didn’t you run, but instead fight and kill them?"
Kent smiled. "Because they attacked me, and as a dragon, I don’t take kindly to it when people attack me." His dragon horns appeared, and deep gold scales lined the sides of his neck.
This sight didn’t surprise the lady in the least. However, Kent sensed a shift in her aura, one that only happens when one feels fear.
’She is afraid of me.’
Of course, he wasn’t about to press his luck. A mere flick of her hand would be all it would take to end his pitiful existence.
"So you are telling me that because they attacked you, you had to kill them."
Kent nodded.
"So if I attack you, will you kill me?"
"That..." he didn’t know what to say.

"So I thought." She let out a chuckle and then turned her head toward the west. "You killed two of my people, dragon. This means you must pay for their lives, or else you won’t be leaving this forest alive. Luckily for you, there is a way out for you to redeem yourself."
Kent sighed and retracted his horns.
He expected as much, so the least he could do was listen to what she had to say. Who knows what kind of danger he would be walking into if he were to run off right now?
In fact, seeing her appearance, he knew that even if he were to escape the forest, there was a high chance she would follow him to the land of humans and kill him.
He just had this gut feeling.
"What do you need from me?" he asked.
She took out a scroll from her space ring, which Kent yet again never expected to see, and threw it at him. He caught it and unfurled it.
"A map."
The scroll contained a map with a red dot marking one spot. Most importantly, the map seemed to cover the entire forest, including the island he arrived on after walking through the portal.
He turned away from the map and stared at the lady before returning to the map. "Are you helping me escape the forest, or do you want me to do something for you?"
"I want the latter. The red dot on the map points to a place where a certain treasure I need can be found. I want you to retrieve it for me."

Kent narrowed his eyes and gave the lady a suspicious glare. "Surely, you have more qualified people who can help you better than I could. I mean, the goat who brought me here is strong enough to do a much better job than I am."

"That is indeed true. However, if caught, not only would he be killed, but I myself would be in danger. However, if a dragon were to be the one to steal the item, all blame will shift to the Northern King."

"Oh, so it is the classic camouflage con, huh? You want to use the face of someone else to steal what doesn’t belong to you." Kent smirked. "I wonder how strong the owner might be that a powerful Immortal Lord like you would be afraid of them."
"She is a Pseudo-Demigod. That is all you need to know."
"Oh hell no. I would rather take my chances with you. At least I know I will be dealing with an Immortal Lord."
"You have no choice, Dragon. You killed two of my people, so even if you were to successfully escape from my domain, I can locate you in the human world and kill you.
Just so you know, I have contacts on almost all seven continents, so you will never be safe from me." She paused and took a breath.
"At least with this mission, you will gain my favour, and I will even help you get to your destination much faster."
Kent shook his head.
The mere fact that he was being sent to go after something that belonged to a Pseudo-Demigod made him wonder just what kind of bad luck he brought with him to Planet Brymrr.
If he got caught, there is a good chance he would die before he realised how it happened. However, if he were to succeed, becoming friends with this lady would also go a long way.
’Or I can just backstab her and make friends with this Pseudo-Demigod.’ That thought was washed from his mind the next second.
Realising how he got here, he knew not to trust his luck by thinking he could play smart with someone whom he knew nothing about. At least, this lady was giving him a way out.
"What do you want me to steal?"
A few hours later, he left the wooden mansion and flew west. It turned out the mission was much more dangerous than he expected. He would have to steal the Golden Bloodline Spirit Fruit.
According to the falcon lady, it had been growing for the past 500,000 years. If taken, there is a great chance her bloodline will upgrade to the next stage.
However, it is being guarded by the Queen of the West, the Blizzard Qilin Queen. She is one of the four overlords of the unknown forest, and a nemesis she had been trying to backstab for a while now.
If Kent manages to get her the fruit, then perhaps she can finally rise to the stage where she would have the means to kill her and be done with their million-year-old rivalry.
So he started flying toward his mission destination, where, if he failed, there would be no coming back.

chapters.title: Chapter 1452: A Very Bad Feeling
paragraphs: After flying for so long, Kent finally came to a stop when he arrived at the border of the Western Queen’s domain.
"Moment of truth." Looking at the forest spanning thousands of miles wide, he took a deep breath to first give himself the morale he needed before venturing into it.
The moment he enters, there would be no turning back.
Calix appeared beside him and narrowed his eyes at the vastness of the forest. "I have a very bad feeling about this," he said, causing Kent to turn and glare at him.
"Do not start raising red flags here, buddy. We just have to get in there, grab what we came for, and be on our merry way."
"The master is right. We just have to grab it and be on our way—that is, if we don’t end up dead before that happens."
Kent chuckled but said nothing.
Calix was not joking when he said he had a very bad feeling. He himself could feel and sense it, so he knew for a fact he had to up his game.
"Oh, while disgraceful, calling a demigod over when in trouble wouldn’t be too bad." His only solace was knowing he could call on powerhouses like Lene, Vargus, and Avother for help when in danger.
But then again, when he finally enters the Star Gateway, where he wouldn’t be able to call for help, doing so now would defeat the purpose of this mission.
So he had to finish it on his own.
"You know, if we pull this off, backstabbing this lady should be the next best thing we should do. I have this feeling she isn’t telling me everything."
"Let’s get the item first, then we focus on who to backstab."
Kent nodded, and soon he was in the shadows. Calix didn’t have to pull him in there since he had his own way of traversing through the shadows.
He, after all, was once the legendary Faceless Assassins, so he needed no help traversing the shadows.
However, to ensure he was concealed, Calix augmented him using his own body. This augmentation strengthened Kent’s connection to the shadows.
So swiftly, he moved through the shadows, heading deeper into the Western Blizzard Queen’s domain.
[Crown Garden]
Deep inside the Western forest, inside a beautiful garden, a grey-haired lady sat under a tree whose leaves and branches formed into a canopy, almost like a crown, sipping tea.

She looked calm, almost as if she had nothing in the world to fear. She also looked human, and judging by how much attention she gave to her appearance and surroundings, it was plain she had some dealings with humans.
From her clothing to the things around her, there was no doubt that she and the humans dealt more than the Falcon Queen did.
A few minutes into her tea, a lady walked into the garden carrying an item on a tray.
"My queen, the merchants delivered the item you asked for." She extended the tray so she could have a look at the item.
It was a green root-like herb.
"This is the last item, huh?"

"Yes, my queen. According to the recipe you found, this is the last herb you needed. In three days, you can finally harvest the Golden Bloodline Spirit Fruit and head to the Ice Continent to look for an alchemist."
"That is indeed the plan, Mei. However, just to be safe, double the guards and strengthen the formations. We cannot allow those two evil demons to cause any trouble this time around."
"My queen should relax. Although she is a pseudo-demigod, unless she can teleport here, there is just no way she could get to the fruit."
"Still, strengthen and double security. I want everything to go well. If I succeed, we will all benefit."
"Okay, my queen." She left a few seconds later and began bolstering security around the fruit. She knew that her Queen’s aim was to become the first demigod-level beast in the Unknown Forest.

Until she became the overlord of the entire forest, she and her people would never be at peace. Already, the Eastern Queen and her aide had set their sights on her domain, so being extra cautious was the only way she could achieve that.
"Thankfully, that human formation expert helped me set up this formation. If they dare come, I will be ready for them." She smirked and went back to drinking her tea.
A few hours passed, but nothing interesting happened.

Kent and Calix had already entered her domain and even managed to come within 110,000 km of the fruit. However, they remained in the shadows, Calix using his Shadow Affinity to spy on the happenings around them.
"I have to be honest, master, there is no way we are getting past this security. It is as if she knew we were coming and she prepared for us," Calix suddenly said, causing Kent to sigh.
"I expected as much." He wasn’t that surprised.

After all, after having some back and forth with the Tower when he received the name of the fruit, he knew how important it was and why she would take extra caution to ensure the security around it was airtight.
However, knowing this mission was of utmost importance, he knew he must get it done if he wanted to leave this place alive.
Of course, he also started looking for things that he could use to complete the mission.
"Calix, see if you can find anything else out of place." Since he couldn’t get to the fruit just yet, there was no need to find a way around that.
Instead, if he could focus on something else, there was a chance he would be able to form a new plan that would take care of the hundreds of Immortals guarding the fruit.
So he locked in and started working alongside Calix.
However, ten minutes into that, a task he had given the Tower a while ago finally ended, and the results were as he expected.
[The master is indeed right. The Eastern Queen is using you as a Trojan horse. Hidden inside the map is a mini teleportation array that would activate the moment you die.]
’Wow, that is dark, Tower. Are you sure?’
[Yes, master. It triggers when you die because it can only be activated using soul essence. When you die, your soul will be transported away, which will leave some form of soul essence in the air.
That would trigger the array, which I believe the Eastern Queen wants to use to come here. This means she planned for your death all this while.]
’Damn.’ Kent felt like he had been conspired against, and that pissed him off. However, he wasn’t about to act out of character at the moment.
’Now, I guess I have a solid reason to backstab her.’
Kent threw the map into the Legion Tower just to be safe. For now, he needed to focus on the mission, which was to get the fruit and escape without the Eastern Queen or Western Queen knowing how.
"Master, I found something," Calix suddenly said after looking around like Kent instructed.
"What is it?"
"Inside a small garden 90,000 km from here, there are three herbs that, from what I know, can be used for alchemy." He paused and took a breather. "Master, I believe she is hoping to concoct a pill."
"Oh, if that is the case, then that changes everything."

chapters.title: Chapter 1453: A New Plan
paragraphs: The last thing Kent wanted was to hear something about someone wanting to concoct a pill.

It was right up his alley, and while he knew he had no way of telling if he would be allowed to approach the Western Queen, hearing she had herbs in her garden and the fact that she might want to concoct a pill gave Kent a new direction to take.
Of course, this quick decision came about because he learned the Eastern Queen was merely using him as a Trojan horse.

The Eastern Queen sent him on this mission with the intention of using him as a suicide agent whose death would trigger an item she and her aide would be able to use to teleport inside the Western Region.
The formation protecting that region was designed to block people out.
However, because the Western Queen and the Northern King are friends, a dragon with a pure bloodline would be able to enter.
Kent has a celestial-grade bloodline, making him even overqualified.
So he was able to enter. However, knowing he was sent to come and die provoked his ego, and so the only thing he wanted now was to get back at her.
This means he needed a new friend, and what better way to make one than by becoming her friend through a shared interest?
"I am going to meet her."
"Hold on a minute there, Master. Are you sure about that?" Calix asked. "For all we know, you showing up would alarm her and cause her to even attack."
It is logical reasoning. However, Kent doesn’t make plans on a whim.
"The formation protecting her domain allows dragons to enter. This means she has some form of trust in dragons. I could use that trust to my advantage.
But even if that doesn’t work, my name is Kent Madson. I have no problem using my words to make her trust me."
Calix said nothing for a few minutes before saying something that made Kent laugh. "Overconfidence is what killed the cat."
"I will be fine. Plus, if this goes well, there is a chance you and Bello will be getting an Immortal Lord Soul Core to absorb. I say it is a win-win situation, don’t you think?"
"That is indeed a win. In that case, good luck, and please don’t die."

Kent nodded, and they started moving forward again. He wanted to teleport into the garden, but since his soul map doesn’t cover that much distance, he needed to move closer to be able to teleport that vast distance.
Thankfully, with Calix’s augmentation, they advanced rather quickly. In no time, he could sense the garden. Luckily for him, he even saw the lady he would be dealing with.
"She is even more beautiful than the Eastern Queen," he muttered. "I guess evil people are uglier both physically and mentally."
After saying that, he prepared himself before teleporting away.
Inside the garden, the Western Queen was relaxing as usual when suddenly, the space around her twisted, and Kent appeared out of thin air.
"Wow, that was quick." Just as he appeared, a blade was held to his neck. The speed at which the lady reacted to his sudden appearance was so quick that Kent never saw it coming.
"Who are you, and how did you get past my formation?" Kent smiled, knowing deep within that he was alive now because he was a dragon.
His next words would determine whether he would live or die.

"Let’s just say the teleportation device I used to travel to this planet malfunctioned, and I ended up in the Eastern Region, where that queen there tried to push a fast one on me by sending me here, hoping you would kill me.
If I die, she gets what she wants, so how about we take a step back and start afresh? I am sure you are going to love what I have to say."
There was no movement from the lady. Her dagger was still held against Kent’s throat, which, from the look in her eyes, showed she wasn’t about to lower her guard.
"I guess we can talk with me at death’s door." Kent held on to his smile. He had no say in the situation he had found himself in. A slight resistance, and he would regret it.
"First of all, my name is Kent Madson. I am from—"
"You are Kent Madson?" Before he could finish his sentence, the Western Queen asked.

"Oh, you have heard of me?" he had already anticipated this happening, but he wasn’t too sure how it would play out. He knew that if the lady recognised his name, there was a chance she might act positively or take the negative path.
After all, he is the legendary Kent Madson.
What if, after learning his identity, she chooses to capture and sell him, or worse, bleed him dry?
The fact that his name appeared three times on different Dao Tablets was a clear indication of his importance as a person and perhaps even as a treasure.
However, there is also a chance she would want to become his friend. Being friends with Kent Madson sure would go a long way, translating into something even better.
But for that to happen, he would have to prove himself first.
As expected, the moment of truth came when the lady asked, "Prove you are Kent Madson, and maybe I will think about sparing you."
Yet again, his answer would lead her to make a good or a bad decision. Either way, he had already come up with the perfect answer.

"If you know me as most do, then you have already heard my name has appeared on the Pill Dao Tablet. This means I am an alchemist, and so I can tell you are looking to concoct a Bloodline Ascension Pill.
The herbs in the garden here and the fact that there is a spirit fruit specifically made for the bloodline gave you away.
However, I can’t help but ask, since you have Tier 14 herbs, how sure are you that a Tier 14 pill will help you upgrade your bloodline from the Immortal Grade to the God Grade?
If you are looking to become a demigod, I have a way that is less dangerous than taking a Bloodline Ascension Pill." Kent paused for a moment to let his words sink in.

"If you want to become a demigod, just say the word, and I will show you the easiest path forward. If you don’t believe me, then you can, of course, kill me or capture me. Either way, you will be putting your life in danger, not me.
If you think I became who I am because I had no backing, then you have another thing coming."
His words hung in the air for several minutes. What he had just said to some degree sounded fake. However, Kent isn’t someone who would tell lies.

That is not possible, especially when his name had already spread far and wide. But even if his name is not known by many, the fact that he had a knife to his neck is all the more reason to be careful about what he says.
This means there is some truth to what he said, and after thinking about it for a while, the Western Queen seemed to also realise that.
"Are you saying if I let you go, you will help me become a demigod?"
"I am saying if you let me go, becoming even a god wouldn’t be impossible."

sentences.text: The last thing Kent wanted was to hear something about someone wanting to concoct a pill.

It was right up his alley, and while he knew he had no way of telling if he would be allowed to approach the Western Queen, hearing she had herbs in her garden and the fact that she might want to concoct a pill gave Kent a new direction to take.
Of course, this quick decision came about because he learned the Eastern Queen was merely using him as a Trojan horse.

The Eastern Queen sent him on this mission with the intention of using him as a suicide agent whose death would trigger an item she and her aide would be able to use to teleport inside the Western Region.
The formation protecting that region was designed to block people out.
However, because the Western Queen and the Northern King are friends, a dragon with a pure bloodline would be able to enter.
Kent has a celestial-grade bloodline, making him even overqualified.
So he was able to enter.
However, knowing he was sent to come and die provoked his ego, and so the only thing he wanted now was to get back at her.
This means he needed a new friend, and what better way to make one than by becoming her friend through a shared interest?
"I am going to meet her."
"Hold on a minute there, Master.
Are you sure about that?" Calix asked.
"For all we know, you showing up would alarm her and cause her to even attack."
It is logical reasoning.
However, Kent doesn’t make plans on a whim.
"The formation protecting her domain allows dragons to enter.
This means she has some form of trust in dragons.
I could use that trust to my advantage.
But even if that doesn’t work, my name is Kent Madson.
I have no problem using my words to make her trust me."
Calix said nothing for a few minutes before saying something that made Kent laugh.
"Overconfidence is what killed the cat."
"I will be fine.
Plus, if this goes well, there is a chance you and Bello will be getting an Immortal Lord Soul Core to absorb.
I say it is a win-win situation, don’t you think?"
"That is indeed a win.
In that case, good luck, and please don’t die."
Kent nodded, and they started moving forward again.
He wanted to teleport into the garden, but since his soul map doesn’t cover that much distance, he needed to move closer to be able to teleport that vast distance.
Thankfully, with Calix’s augmentation, they advanced rather quickly.
In no time, he could sense the garden.
Luckily for him, he even saw the lady he would be dealing with.
"She is even more beautiful than the Eastern Queen," he muttered.
"I guess evil people are uglier both physically and mentally."
After saying that, he prepared himself before teleporting away.
Inside the garden, the Western Queen was relaxing as usual when suddenly, the space around her twisted, and Kent appeared out of thin air.
"Wow, that was quick." Just as he appeared, a blade was held to his neck.
The speed at which the lady reacted to his sudden appearance was so quick that Kent never saw it coming.
"Who are you, and how did you get past my formation?" Kent smiled, knowing deep within that he was alive now because he was a dragon.
His next words would determine whether he would live or die.

"Let’s just say the teleportation device I used to travel to this planet malfunctioned, and I ended up in the Eastern Region, where that queen there tried to push a fast one on me by sending me here, hoping you would kill me.
If I die, she gets what she wants, so how about we take a step back and start afresh?
I am sure you are going to love what I have to say."
There was no movement from the lady.
Her dagger was still held against Kent’s throat, which, from the look in her eyes, showed she wasn’t about to lower her guard.
"I guess we can talk with me at death’s door." Kent held on to his smile.
He had no say in the situation he had found himself in.
A slight resistance, and he would regret it.
"First of all, my name is Kent Madson.
I am from—"
"You are Kent Madson?" Before he could finish his sentence, the Western Queen asked.
"Oh, you have heard of me?" he had already anticipated this happening, but he wasn’t too sure how it would play out.
He knew that if the lady recognised his name, there was a chance she might act positively or take the negative path.
After all, he is the legendary Kent Madson.
What if, after learning his identity, she chooses to capture and sell him, or worse, bleed him dry?
The fact that his name appeared three times on different Dao Tablets was a clear indication of his importance as a person and perhaps even as a treasure.
However, there is also a chance she would want to become his friend.
Being friends with Kent Madson sure would go a long way, translating into something even better.
But for that to happen, he would have to prove himself first.
As expected, the moment of truth came when the lady asked, "Prove you are Kent Madson, and maybe I will think about sparing you."
Yet again, his answer would lead her to make a good or a bad decision.
Either way, he had already come up with the perfect answer.

chapters.title: Chapter 1454: Offering His Help
paragraphs: Although he never planned on making such a big promise, Kent knew deep down that it was the only chance he had to secure his safety and leave the forest early. He needed to at least take the danger off his back first.
So he said what he had to say and hoped for the best.
As expected, the Western Queen entered a state of contemplation that lasted five minutes. Once she made up her mind, she took a deep breath and pulled the dagger away.
"Go ahead. Your next couple of words will determine if I will let you live or die."
"That is all I asked for." Kent shook off the pressure she placed on him when her dagger was held firmly against his neck. Once he recovered, he asked,
"What is the grade of your Spirit Root?"
"Immortal grade," she answered, her gaze narrowing slightly
"How about your soul tier?"
"Tier 28."
"That is akin to an Emperor, huh? Not too bad for a non-soul cultivator." He was genuinely impressed to hear that she had reached Tier 28 in soul cultivation.

That is not something those who aren’t cultivating their soul can easily achieve. In fact, at the Immortal stages, it takes several years to move between tiers, so her being Tier 28 is actually impressive.
"What about body cultivation?"
"Peak Sage Body."

"Wow. You are more impressive than I thought. This will make things much easier for me." Once again, her body cultivation was far ahead of what he expected. She had even reached the level of his wives.

They all had reached the Sage Body or higher thanks to the resources the tower had to offer. Even he wouldn’t have heard of some of the body-tempering treasures if it weren’t for his wives exploring the tower shop whenever they wanted to temper their bodies.
So, for someone having no such treasures to reach the Sage body, she might have worked hard for it.
"I have to be honest with you. If you had tried taking the Bloodline Ascension Pill with these qualities that you have just told me, your success rate would have been below 30%.
Of course, you have decent soul cultivation and body cultivation. However, when it comes to Spirit Root, you are still lacking. Becoming a demigod is not as simple as becoming an Immortal.
It takes three things to become a god. First is the Spirit Root. You need a high-grade Spirit Root to cultivate divine essence.

At the demigod stage, you learn how to wield divine essence, which, if mastered, would finally allow you to form your Law and become a god. So you will need a high-tier spirit root to wield divine Qi.

The second is soul cultivation. The soul of an Immortal is not the same as the soul of a god. A god has a law-governed soul, so at the demigod stage, one is required to nurture their soul to the point it can handle their Law.
A weaker soul would break under such pressure.

The last is body cultivation. The body of a god is the most precious thing about any god. If a god were to die now, as an alchemist, I could extract so many valuable things from them and use them to make powerful pills.
A body cultivator can even refine such a body and use the essence to refine their own body. One thing to note, a powerful body at the demigod stage means a powerful god body.
I am telling you these things because to become a demigod, you need to be at least Tier 29 in soul cultivation, have a Nirvana Body, and possess an Immortal-grade Spirit Root.

You already qualify in Spirit Root, so you have to handle body and soul. Luckily for you, I have a way to increase your soul and body cultivation. I will even throw in a bonus by helping you get a God-grade Spirit Root.
This way, your focus shouldn’t be solely on the demigod stage. You must see much deeper"
Kent made sure all openings were covered before he turned to face the Western Queen. "So what do you think? Do you want to trust me, or do we go back to you trying to kill me?"
She stood there for a great period of time before she nodded.
"All you said is how to give me a better chance at becoming a demigod, not actually how to become one."
"Oh, that is the easiest part of all," he laughed. "By the time you reach these requirements, I will be ready to concoct a good Bloodline Ascension Pill."
"How can I trust you aren’t just trying to save your neck? For all I know, being sent by a Peak Immortal Lord and a Pseudo-Demigod can make you say just about anything to save yourself."
While Kent felt foolish for not seeing through the Eastern Queen’s scheme, he had now been enlightened, and so he would pay her back in full.
He is vengeful by nature, so before leaving, he will get his revenge. This is why he even wants to make sure he leaves on good terms with the Western Queen.
"I have to admit I was fooled by her. However, in my defense, I was indeed trying to protect my neck. I may be strong, but without enough time to prepare, killing an Immortal Lord is beyond me.
However, now that I have time to prepare, they will soon be dead. I can promise you that. As for helping you, I just want a safe passage to the human cities.
As I said before, I ended up here by accident, so I would like to leave as soon as possible.
So I guess the question now should be, are you willing to trust me? I wouldn’t just be helping you become a demigod one day, but I would also be taking care of two powerful threats."
In the end, she had no reason to doubt him. Kent had already made a name for himself, so she decided to trust him.
If he turns out to be a fake, that would be her loss for trusting the wrong person.
"I will trust you, but you must prove you are speaking the truth by giving me the method first. Once I confirm you are telling the truth, I will let you go."
"Oh, that is simple then." Kent extended his hand, and a fruit appeared in it. "Here you go. Just eat this, and your Spirit Root will upgrade to the God Grade."
The Western Queen looked at him from head to toe as if trying to say she was not falling for his scheme. Seeing this, Kent took a bite out of the fruit and produced another one.
"I can take another bite, but that will defeat the purpose of the fruit. Just a small bite takes a large part of the essence with it."
This time, she only hesitated for a minute before she nodded and took it. "Go ahead, eat it."
After a few seconds of hesitating yet again, she took a bite out of the fruit. When she tasted the essence, her eyes widened.
"Eat it all, dear. You never know when good things will come your way."
While eating, she could literally feel her Spirit Root growing stronger by the second. It was unreal, but feeling her own strength rise made her lower her guard.
If Kent wanted, he could attack and severely injure her. However, seeing her experience what just about anyone else experienced when they took the Ambrosia Apple, he just smiled.
It took a couple of hours after eating, but she climbed to the God Grade. Once that happened, her attitude toward Kent changed completely.

chapters.title: Chapter 1455: Becoming Friends
paragraphs: "So what do you think now? Do you think I can be trusted now?" Kent asked with a smug expression.
Hearing his question, the Western Queen stared at him for a few minutes before a smile appeared on her face.
She had her doubts. However, after seeing what Kent could do, all those doubts were cleared. She was now able to trust him.
Even if not trusted completely, the mere fact that her Spirit Root had reached the God Grade said it all. Kent helped her, and she could not deny that.
"I suppose I should have trusted you earlier on. However, in my defense, I was apprehensive because you were sent by my enemies."
"Fair enough. However, now that I have proven I can be trusted, don’t you think it is time to tell me your name?"
"Randel. My name is Randel."
"Beautiful name. I guess you are not only beautiful; your name matches your looks."
She smiled, which was a good sign because, after all, Kent had no plans to live inside the forest for long. The more familiar they get, the better.
But he also promised to help her, so there was that too.

"I promised to help you, and I will. However, I also have to leave this forest since this is not my destination. That said, I will leave some treasures with you that will aid you in both soul cultivation and body tempering.

Right now, you are just a step away from achieving the Nirvana Body, so I will leave the required treasures for that. If you pay more attention to your training, you will achieve that in a few months.
There is also the issue of your soul. That, too, will depend on how much effort you put in, but I have no doubt that reaching Tier 30 in less than a year wouldn’t be impossible.

I will leave a communication device so that when you reach the required stages, you can call me. I hope by then, even without the Bloodline Ascension Pill, you can break through to the demigod stage."
He retrieved a storage pouch containing so many treasures that Randel had never seen before in this life. Kent used 4 billion tower points to purchase them since he had more than enough.

"I have no interest in trying to deceive you, Randel. I just want to be on my way, so trust me when I say becoming a demigod and eventually a god is something you can achieve irrespective of what you believe."

Of course, Kent isn’t doing this just because he wants to leave the forest in one piece. Just like how he wanted to form a good relationship with the Eastern Queen before she turned out to be scum, he wanted the same with Randel.
She is an Immortal Lord on the path to becoming a demigod.
While he has demigods and gods at his disposal, having more is not too bad. Randel is a Blizzard Qilin, someone whose powers will come in handy in battle.
The ability to control blizzards is good for wide-area attacks, so having her as a friend is better than playing a fast one on her.
"A year from now, when you finally make the progress you are hoping to make, be sure to know I never lie when it comes to helping those I consider friends."
Randel raised her eyes to give Kent a critical look before asking, "So are we friends?"
"I believe so. Of course, we have just met each other, but I have no doubt that in no time, we will become great friends."
"I don’t mind becoming your friend. However, if later I find out all this was a scam and that you have deceived me, I will look for every way possible to kill you."
Kent laughed and replied, "Rest assured, I have no interest in deceiving you. If anything, I want you to succeed so I can brag and say I have a demigod friend called Randel."
She smiled as well.
"Don’t pluck the Golden Blood Spirit Fruit just yet. Let it stay on the tree for now. I will let you know when I am ready to concoct a Tier 15 pill so you can pluck it."
Randel nodded and asked, "Where do you intend to go? I have connections with a few merchants who travel the various continents in this world. I can ask one of them to take you where you want to go."
"That is a great offer, but if I know which continent is closest to this place, I will be grateful."
"The Ice Continent is the closest. It is about a five-day journey from this place. However, you need to have some form of ice resistance if you want to survive the weather there."
"I have that covered." He has Absolute Ice, so that place will be like a home to him.
"One last thing, do you happen to know who the ruler of this planet is?"
"No. However, you can find out more when you get to the Ice Continent. Their capital is Snow City, so ask around there, or even better, pay for information at any information guild.
But be careful who you ask. Some are evil and would sell bad information just so they can later double-cross you."
She tapped into her space ring and retrieved a jade token. "Take this to the Green Ice Restaurant and ask for Lord Bimk. Show this to him, and he will aid you in any way you want."
Kent received the token. "Thank you."
"No need for that. As you said, we are now friends," she said with a smile.
"Sure." Kent also smiled.

Now that he had received all the information he needed, leaving was the most logical thing to do. However, he did promise Calix that at the end of the day, he and Bello would have powerful souls to absorb.
So he would make that happen.

He reached into the tower storage and pulled out a disc-shaped item. A couple of years ago, while still on Sonox, the planet he first arrived on, he used this disc to fight a group of people who just wouldn’t listen to advice.
It is a battlefield located inside a pocket dimension. Inside, unless one of them dies, they would remain locked in.
Kent planned to use it against the Eastern Queen and her friend, who tried to pull a fast one on him.
He activated the battlefield, and within it, the three-headed lion’s large body, which Kenna had killed, appeared. A second later, Bello appeared beside it and vanished into its body.
A minute later, the lion opened its eyes and stood up.
Since it had come to this, Bello would be using one of his abilities, which allows him to possess the bodies of dead beings and detonate their core.
Detonating the core of an Immortal Emperor would surely severely injure even a Pseudo-Demigod, if not kill them completely.
A few seconds after Bello successfully possessed the three-headed lion’s body, the map the Eastern Queen gave Kent appeared inside the battlefield.
Then, a second later, a Spirit Grape Fruit appeared beside it, and after a moment of suspense, it exploded, releasing soul essence.
The scroll glowed, and then a formation opened.

"Don’t pluck the Golden Blood Spirit Fruit just yet.
Let it stay on the tree for now.
I will let you know when I am ready to concoct a Tier 15 pill so you can pluck it."
Randel nodded and asked, "Where do you intend to go?
I have connections with a few merchants who travel the various continents in this world.
I can ask one of them to take you where you want to go."
"That is a great offer, but if I know which continent is closest to this place, I will be grateful."
"The Ice Continent is the closest.
It is about a five-day journey from this place.
However, you need to have some form of ice resistance if you want to survive the weather there."
"I have that covered." He has Absolute Ice, so that place will be like a home to him.
"One last thing, do you happen to know who the ruler of this planet is?"
"No.
However, you can find out more when you get to the Ice Continent.
Their capital is Snow City, so ask around there, or even better, pay for information at any information guild.
But be careful who you ask.
Some are evil and would sell bad information just so they can later double-cross you."
She tapped into her space ring and retrieved a jade token.
"Take this to the Green Ice Restaurant and ask for Lord Bimk.
Show this to him, and he will aid you in any way you want."
Kent received the token.
"Thank you."
"No need for that.
As you said, we are now friends," she said with a smile.
"Sure." Kent also smiled.
Now that he had received all the information he needed, leaving was the most logical thing to do.
However, he did promise Calix that at the end of the day, he and Bello would have powerful souls to absorb.
So he would make that happen.
He reached into the tower storage and pulled out a disc-shaped item.
A couple of years ago, while still on Sonox, the planet he first arrived on, he used this disc to fight a group of people who just wouldn’t listen to advice.
It is a battlefield located inside a pocket dimension.
Inside, unless one of them dies, they would remain locked in.
Kent planned to use it against the Eastern Queen and her friend, who tried to pull a fast one on him.
He activated the battlefield, and within it, the three-headed lion’s large body, which Kenna had killed, appeared.
A second later, Bello appeared beside it and vanished into its body.
A minute later, the lion opened its eyes and stood up.
Since it had come to this, Bello would be using one of his abilities, which allows him to possess the bodies of dead beings and detonate their core.
Detonating the core of an Immortal Emperor would surely severely injure even a Pseudo-Demigod, if not kill them completely.
A few seconds after Bello successfully possessed the three-headed lion’s body, the map the Eastern Queen gave Kent appeared inside the battlefield.
Then, a second later, a Spirit Grape Fruit appeared beside it, and after a moment of suspense, it exploded, releasing soul essence.
The scroll glowed, and then a formation opened.

chapters.title: Chapter 1456: Core Explosion
paragraphs: [Ten Minutes Before The Map Activated - Eastern Region (Wooden Mansion)]
"It’s been hours already. Why hasn’t he died yet?" the Pseudo-Demigod asked, her expression turning ugly.
It is clear her patience is thinning since it has been hours already, but Kent didn’t die, so the transfer formation embedded in the map would trigger.
She was the one who came up with this scheme simply because she wanted her hands on the Golden Blood Spirit Fruit.
She had already reached the threshold to step into the rank of a Demigod, so with the fruit, she would be able to do that.
In her hand, she would have had more success than Randel.
She also wants to become a Queen who, over time, will rule over the entire forest. When she met the Eastern Queen, she first wanted to kill her and take her place.
However, after their initial clash, she realised that while she may appear stronger than her, the Eastern Queen is too fast for a single attack to land on her.
It looked from an objective viewpoint, the eastern queen was far more deadly than her.
So instead of being at each other’s throats, they formed a blood contract where the Eastern Queen will help her become a Demigod, and in turn, she too will help her reach that stage.
The Eastern Queen had no plans to leave the forest for long, since her ambitions are more focused on world domination. So after they achieve their cultivation goals, they would part ways.
Kent’s accidental appearance in the Eastern Region was an unexpected surprise and a good opportunity to move forward with their plan.
But even after a day had passed and nothing had happened, they started to wonder many things.
"Relax. He already knew I meant business, so he wouldn’t try to pull a fast one. But even if he did, there is no chance he would live long enough to enjoy his freedom.
I have already informed my people, so they will be on the lookout for him."
"That is reassuring to hear, but how do we know he hasn’t joined forces with that bitch?"

"Oh, please, don’t make me laugh. We both know she wouldn’t hesitate to snap his head off when she senses his presence. The last thing we should consider is them becoming a team. I am sure any moment from now, we will be invading her domain."
The Pseudo-Demigod wanted to say something, but she forced herself to stop. In hindsight, even if Kent somehow manages to escape, there is a big chance they would find another way.
Ten minutes into their panic talk, they both jolted to their feet when a formation suddenly opened.
"Told you." The Eastern Queen summoned a spear and walked toward the formation. The Pseudo-Demigod summoned no weapon. She casually walked into the formation and began forming a hand seal.

"I will take her on while you go for the fruit. Once we get it, there will be no need to kill any more. We can retreat before she activates that annoying domain of hers," the Eastern Queen said before stepping into the formation.
The next second, space warped, and they vanished from the room.
[Inside the Battlefield]
Bello, still possessing the three-headed lion’s body, had already prepared to go boom the moment his targets appeared.
Kent is still on the outside; however, he can see everything happening inside the battlefield. His time to enter had yet to arrive, so he stood there, watching as the formation grew brighter.
A few seconds into the wait, two people arrived.
When the Eastern Queen and the Pseudo-Demigod saw the three-headed lion, their pupils shrank. That was because they recognised it, and as far as they knew, it had already died.
So how then is it standing before them now?
This question made them instantly raise their guard. However, with what Bello had in store for them, raising their guard was futile.
"My master says hi." With that, all six eyes on the three heads glowed crimson, and then everywhere turned red.

On the outside, the connection between Kent and Bello was severed, and a wave of pain slammed into his head. It turned out sharing the same eyesight with Bello came at a cost, one that left him breathing wildly for a few seconds.

Meanwhile, inside the battlefield, the moment Bello exploded the three-headed lion’s core, everything became quiet. Even the screams coming from the two ladies were drowned out, with only red light filling the space.
It took over ten seconds for the light to clear.

When it cleared, the Eastern Queen lay immobile, her body completely black and scarred, while the Pseudo-Demigod remained on her knees, her chest rising and falling like she had been struck by thunder.
Her skin had also turned black, and judging by how weak her breath kept coming out, there is no doubt she was not too far from death’s door herself.
Suddenly, Kent appeared inside the battlefield, a smile playing on his lips.
"Looks like I have to start collecting dead bodies," he laughed.

Seeing the devastation caused by a single explosion, he became more drawn to the unique ability Bello possessed. The ability to possess the body of a dead being and explode its core long after it died is just too overpowered.
"But before that, allow me to send you away drowning." The Underworld Soul River rose, and the large doors swung open, unleashing the water coming directly from the River Styx into the battlefield.
In an instant, the Pseudo-Demigod was drowned, her screaming mixing with the already soul-shattering howls coming from the river.
It took her just four seconds to succumb to the Underworld Soul River. However, Kent kept it open for ten seconds more just so he could store some more soul pressure into the Death Star Cannon.

In the end, he managed to finish off the Pseudo-Demigod, and with that, the battle that he would have lost if he were to face them in person had been taken care of with an Immortal Emperor core explosion and the Underworld Soul River.
Once he confirmed they were indeed dead, Kent summoned Calix, who appeared with a stunned expression. He was hiding inside Kent’s shadow all this time, so he also saw the devastation of both attacks.
"I guess you were right. With the right preparation, killing just about anyone is possible," Calix said, walking toward the body of the Eastern Queen.
"Never doubt the power of prep time." Kent smiled, watching as Calix retrieved the soul core from the Eastern Queen’s body.
He then proceeded and removed that of the Pseudo-Demigod.
"I suppose you are right, Master."
Kent nodded. "Give the big one to Bello when he wakes up." Calix nodded as well and vanished back into the soul universe.
It would take Bello a few days to get his body back in shape. By then, Kent would be long gone. Now that the hard stuff had been handled, he had no reason to stay much longer.
He waved his hand, and the bodies vanished. The next second, he appeared inside the garden, the two bodies appearing with him.
Randel’s eyes widened when she saw the dead bodies.
"As I said, I wouldn’t leave with them still breathing." Randel could only stare at him, stunned.
In the end, she had no choice but to completely believe she had indeed met the real Kent Madson and could confirm that his fame wasn’t exaggerated.

chapters.title: Chapter 1457: Leaving the Forest
paragraphs: With the Eastern Queen and her co-conspirator dead, Kent has no reason to stay in the forest any longer. He had made it so that regardless of what excuse Randel raises, it will amount to nothing.
He had helped her upgrade her Spirit Root to God-grade and even left her with treasures to aid her in body tempering and soul cultivation.
Aside from that, he had taken care of her biggest rivals, so he had no reason to even consider staying another minute inside the forest when he could be on his way toward human civilization.
"I have already done my part. Now is your time to uphold your end of the deal."
"Of course. I will take you to the edge of the forest as I promised. Since you have no plans on staying for long, we can leave now."
Thus, they left and headed deeper into the forest. It took them a couple of hours, but they finally arrived at the edge of the forest, where Kent could finally be on his way.
"Contact me with the communication crystal I gave you if something happens," Kent said, and she nodded.
"Until next time, then."

He left, and after standing there for a few minutes, Randel also turned and retreated back into the forest. She is now safe from those who wish to oppress her, so she has time to focus on her cultivation.
As for the domain of the Eastern Queen, it would be a while before anyone realised she was gone. By then, she would become strong enough to lay claim to it.
Kent had done her a solid favour, one that she never expected to happen.

So as she retreated further back into the forest, she couldn’t help feeling both happy and expectant of what would happen later when she could finally stand and beat her chest, claiming supreme authority over the entire forest.
There are many such forests where, while there are small rulers like kings and queens, there is a central authority—mostly a god who acts as an Emperor or Empress.
The reason why she wants to become an Empress is simple: if she becomes the Empress of the forest, her divinity will be powered by the beasts under her command.
Maybe that was what the Pseudo-Demigod was after, but ended up dead instead.
She will have an entire forest to rule. That kind of power would be something she could harness to do all kinds of things.
So she is looking forward to what the future holds.
Kent, on the other hand, also quickly moved further away from the forest. Randel said it would take her a day, maybe two, to reach the main road leading from the forest.
From there, if he were to walk, it would take him a week to reach Snow City, while flying would take him a maximum of three days.
Kent was in a rush, but not that much in a rush since he wanted to wait for Bello to wake up first. Even so, with his flame veins boosting his speed, he was moving much faster than a normal person.
A day later, he appeared on the main road.
Luckily for him, a few hours after he appeared on the main road, a carriage coming from somewhere entered his soul map range.
Kent quickly scanned them and found out it was a carrier carriage carrying goods from somewhere to the city. It had five guards and one driver, everyone below the True Immortal stage.
Although he could hide from them, he decided to wait for them to catch up to him. There is no danger in meeting some people when he had just arrived in such a place.
The forest was a great experience, but if possible, he would love to have more relationships with humans.
This is because he needed information on Inaya, and what better way to get this information than by interacting with people more?
So as expected, when the carriage caught up, they slowed down.
"What is your name, kid?" one of the guards asked, using Kent’s cultivation base to determine his age.
"Jaqen, Sir,"
"Jaqen, can’t say I have heard that name before."
"It is not a common name."

"Indeed. Why are you walking all alone? These roads are so dangerous that someone like you shouldn’t be here alone," yet again, using Kent’s Tier 19 cultivation, he came to the conclusion that he was weak.
Of course, Kent played the weak kid since he wanted to gain their favour.
"I was travelling with a merchant caravan, but they abandoned me when I had no money left to pay for the rest of the journey. I have been walking since."
"That is sad. Mind riding with us?"
Thus, Kent got a ride that, judging by how fast they were moving, would take them less than three days to get to their destination.
"Have you been to Snow City before?" When inside the carriage, another guard by the name of Li asked.

"No. This is my first time. I have an ice affinity, and since my family is all flame users, they abandoned me, so I decided to come here and try my luck. Maybe one day I will also become an Immortal."
The five guards and the driver nodded. Kent could see they were good people, considering that since he had climbed in, none showed any sign of disdain toward him.
They all seemed to genuinely like him. Maybe it was because he looked innocent and handsome. In the past, whenever Jest travelled, he always met three groups of people.
The first group consisted of evil men who just wanted to attack him for his money and treasures. He had dealt with thousands of them and knew how to tell them apart.

The second group was the jealous ones. These people just got jealous of his good looks. Even when he was a skinny slave, he had the looks and smile that melted almost every heart. So they mostly become jealous of him because they can’t have his looks.

The last group was, of course, those who saw him as an innocent flower that must be protected. Most of the people in this group were women. However, he met men, too, just like how this group of six seemed chummy with him.
Of course, he could be mistaken, considering he gave the classic sob story about being abandoned by both his family and the merchant team he was traveling with.
It had been billions of years, but that sob story still worked.
So seeing them try to make him feel comfortable made him feel like he hadn’t changed that much. At heart, he was still Jest.
Their conversation only kept going on for hours. Even when night came, aside from raising their guard to prepare for anything, they kept riding.
Kent was also using the Soul Map to scan their surroundings just in case they missed something. Thankfully, as the second day was coming to an end, Snow City appeared in the distance.
It was as its name suggested. The city was built from ice, and snow kept raining down on it. The closer they moved toward the city gate, the more mesmerizing it became.

Jest had been here before, but compared to how it looked then and now, the difference was very vast. Even from several thousand miles back, he could feel the cold. Thankfully, with his ice resistance, he wouldn’t face any danger.
’Finally, after being away for who knows how long, I am back in this place.’

chapters.title: Chapter 1458: Snow City
paragraphs: Many years ago, Jest arrived in Snow City with a large wound across his chest and over ten attackers on his tail.
It was when he was roaming the world, challenging one swordsman after another in the hope that he would find a way to break past the Sword Saint stage.
Back then, he accidentally entered a forbidden zone where a Sword King lived. When he discovered what a blunder he had made, he apologized and left, but he didn’t get far before he was attacked.
He managed to escape, but not before he had his chest split open by the Sword King.

Back then, Sword Kings were a big deal, so when word got out that a mere Sword Saint broke into the cultivation garden of a Sword King, Jest had to go on the run since all who wanted to suck up to the sword king came after him.
Today, as he entered Snow City, memories of that chilling encounter came to mind, and he just couldn’t help but smile inwardly.
’I wonder if that bastard is still alive.’
The Sword King, who was the reason he had to go on a 30-year run, came to mind, and he just couldn’t help but wonder if he was still alive.
It’s been so long since he died, so there is a good chance that Sword King had long since died also.
’I am just being petty at this point. Even if he is alive, there is a huge chance he has already become a Sword God. Seeking him out would just be me courting death.’
Of course, he could not relax without knowing a thing or two about that bastard.

He turned to the guard named Li and asked, "Before coming to this place after my family disowned me, I learned a very long time ago, when swordsmanship wasn’t as big as it is now, that a Sword King by the name of Sword Ribbon used to live in this city. Is that true?"
"Of course it is true. However, don’t make that mistake again. Refering to him as sword king will get you killed. He is now a Sword Supreme and has long reached a stage none of us can fathom."
"Oh, my bad."

"That’s alright, kid." Li placed his hand on his shoulder and said, "It turned out he and the legendary Lord Genesis—you know, the father of swordsmanship—were friends back in the day. So later, when Lord Genesis reached the peak, he was one of the many he personally helped."
"That is great to hear, I suppose."

"It is true. Lord Genesis was generous in everything he did. His generosity has made many legends and still does. So while here, whenever you see a statue of a swordsman—just any swordsman—be respectful, or else you will find yourself in deep trouble."
"Thanks for the advice, Mr. Li. I will be sure to remember that." After saying that, he leaned back and started to think.
’Unbelievable. To think I actually became friends with that jackass. What was I even thinking?’
He smiled inwardly, a bit amused.
’It is not too late. One day, after I rise back to the peak, I can still get my revenge.’
Pettiness was rooted in his being, so he would always remember, and one day, he would make sure he got back at that bastard.
’Then again, why would I help him when I promised myself back then to kill him?’ This question remained a mystery.
With the carriers taking him along, he entered the city without paying at the gate. They quickly headed deeper into the city.
His thoughts remained in his head since the scenery he was seeing seemed to captivate his senses. There was just no way he expected Snow City to become this beautiful.
After 30 minutes, the carriage stopped.

"This is as far as we can take you, kid. Take this and rent a room for the night. Tomorrow, head to the Mission Guild and see if you can find a mission that will pay for your daily upkeep and also aid you in your cultivation.
Every last day of the month, you can come to the Dream Store and ask for me. If I am around, I will help you in any way I can."
Kent nodded and accepted the money. After thanking them, he alighted from the carriage and watched them leave.
"Good people. One day, I will repay your kindness."
Kent gave them one last bow before spreading his Soul Map. Since he had no idea which part of Snow City he was in, he decided to find a room and rent it for the night.
Tomorrow morning, he would head to the Green Ice Restaurant and look for the Bimk guy Randel said could help him however he wanted.
His first mission is to find Inaya’s whereabouts. She is the main reason he came, so he would look for her first before handling the other things.
He quickly found a hotel which was about 50,000 km from him. Following the direction in his Soul Map, he quickly made his way toward the hotel.
It took him a few minutes to reach the hotel.
"Welcome to One Night Hotel. How long do you plan on staying?" a lady at the door greeted him. Hearing the name of the hotel, a smile appeared on his face.
"I guess I will be staying for just one night."
The lady also smiled, showing this wasn’t her first time hearing such a reply. She pointed at a lady sitting behind a desk. "You can book your room and pay there."
Kent nodded and headed to the receptionist. There, it took him just two minutes to pay and secure a room. He headed upstairs and, without much difficulty, unlocked and entered his room.
It was nothing fancy, just a bed and a chair.
Kent had no plan to stay there, so he entered the tower the moment he entered the room. The main reason he booked the room was to make his presence known in the city.
If someone or something were to be following him, they would find his trail where he wanted them to, because that was what he wanted them to find. He wants to draw attention from the tower.
Also, he needed a secure space to enter and exit the tower, so finding a room sounded like a good idea. He can’t just come and go in the middle of the street like that.
The tower is monitoring everything, so if someone were to come to the room, he would be alerted immediately.
He appeared inside the Alchemy Tower, where he started working on Tier 14 pills. Since it would be nine hours before daybreak, that amounted to nine days inside the tower.
There was plenty of time for him to make some progress.
Meanwhile, back inside the dungeon, Unity had finally broken free from the cocoon. It turned out she had received memories from the Goddess of Love.
Initially, he only received memories from Artemis. Now, the goddess of love had also returned to her.
The cocoon was just a way to rebuild her body so she could use abilities related to that life. Being the Goddess of Love has many benefits, and she has just started to awaken some of them.
However, now that she is out, they have to head to the 10th floor.
It is a 37-floor dungeon. They had done nine, meaning they have 28 more to go.
"Let’s not waste our time." Vexthra opened the portal, and they soon left the 9th floor. The earlier they get things done, the better.

chapters.title: Chapter 1459: The Tenth Floor - The Planet Devourer (1)
paragraphs: Vexthra and her team arrived on the 10th floor expecting a different scenery. However, what greeted them was no scenery pleasing to the eye.
There was nothing tangible in sight that would suggest they had even arrived in a world.
All they could see was a dirty atmosphere, with dusty wind blowing everywhere. In several places, the sky could be seen split, lines extending as far as the eye could see.
"A dying planet," both Vexthra and Miryssa muttered in unison.
"Everyone, be careful. We are on a dying planet. The slightest mistake and you will be dead," Vexthra’s warning reached everyone, causing them to nod seriously at her words.
Even the overly enthusiastic Kaizo chose caution since he could tell the very air they were breathing was hazardous.
"Big sister, what is wrong with this world?" Princess Lovina asked. "I can taste and smell poison in the air, so much poison."
Since she is a poison expert, nobody doubted her when she said she could sense poison everywhere. The only question worth answering was the one she asked.
What is wrong with the world?

"It is dying. This means the spiritual veins of the planet have been devoured, and with no veins left to support the planetary core, it is slowly breaking." She paused and took a deep breath as if trying to smell something.
"At this rate, it will take less than ten years, perhaps even less, for the core to completely shatter. Once that happens, the planet will become uninhabitable."
Just as she said that, the mission details appeared. She shared them with everyone.
⟦Name: Planet Killer Dungeon⟧
⟦Floor Name: The Planet Devourer (10th)⟧
⟦Power Level: True Immortal (Peak)⟧
⟦Description:

↠ Long ago, the world known as Vorthal was one of the richest cultivation planets in the Eastern Galaxy. Its spiritual veins stretched across the continents, nourishing billions of cultivators and countless ancient sects.
↠ But greed led to its downfall.

↠ In their attempt to achieve eternal life, the Seven Sovereign Sects performed a forbidden ritual meant to summon a cosmic entity capable of devouring planets and converting their essence into immortal energy.
↠ They wanted more despite having the best among many planets. Greed had entered their hearts, making them do the unthinkable.
↠ The ritual succeeded.
↠ But what descended upon the planet was not a servant... but a Planet Devourer.
↠ The creature known as Vorath, the World Eater, consumed the planet’s spiritual veins and slaughtered every living being on the world.
↠ In its final moments, the planet itself used its dying will to seal Vorath beneath the planetary core.
↠ For thousands of years, the seal held.
↠ But recently, the seal has begun to weaken. If Vorath awakens fully, it will devour the planet and evolve into a Cosmic Calamity Beast, capable of destroying entire star systems.
↠ Should that happen, the surrounding galaxies will fall into catastrophe.⟧
⟦Your mission is to locate the planetary core and kill Vorath – The Planet Devourer before it fully awakens from the seal.⟧
Rewards
↠ 100 Billion Tower Points
↠ 1 Trillion Soul Essence
↠ Limit Breaker Key (Everybody)
↠ Innate Talent Awakening Pill
↠ World Core Fragment (Extremely rare treasure)
↠ Planet Devourer Bloodline Crystal
Everyone took a deep breath after reading through the mission a second time. The details were clear, and the implications were easy to read.
"How can people be this stupid?" Elaine suddenly muttered. "From what I understood, this planet sounded like a haven. Why go the extra mile to cause its downfall?"

"Oh, believe me when I tell you this is nothing compared to what others have done in the past and keep doing. In this vast universe, there are people who just want more, regardless of how much they already have."
Vexthra’s words made them all take a deep breath.

The Planet Devourer sounded like it had done its job since, based on what the people wanted, devouring everything seemed logical. The civilians dying was a bummer, but it wasn’t like they were innocents either.
They had hoped to use it to devour other planets and transfer their essence to their own.
Instead, they became its food.
"It is a threat to every immortal world," Miryssa said.

"From what I know, when a planet dies, its core releases all stored essence back into the universe. While it is too contaminated for us to absorb, considering all the spiritual veins have already been absorbed, the Planet Devourer will be able to absorb everything.
Considering how vast the planet is, I am sure reaching the peak of the Immortal Lord stage or even becoming a demigod would be possible after devouring all that essence.
If that were to happen, then the entire galaxy would be in danger. It will rampage everywhere, and when it finally reaches the stage to ascend, the God World will be next."

"This means we should kill it as early as possible, right?" Zareth asked, his expression changing a bit. He was the only one who could understand just how dangerous this mission would become if the worst case were to happen.
After all, he has the bloodline of the World Serpent, one of the deadliest devourers in the universe. Even now, he could tell they would have to be extra careful.
"Yes. It has to die, and you will lead the battle," Vexthra answered. "Among us, you are the only one with a devourer bloodline, so this mission falls on your lap.

However, because every devourer has an affinity for the void, Elyndra and Ingrid will come with you as well. Lastly, Enkay and Veydris will also join. All five of you are the only people qualified to get close to the planet’s core without dying violently."
Since the devourer itself has a void affinity and the planet also seems to be dying rapidly, there is a great chance the void will be unstable.
Zareth has void affinity, and he can also devour. Elyndra has space affinity, so she can aid where the void cannot. Ingrid is a Voidling, so she would be like a fish in water.
As for Enkay, while his affinity for the void is limited, he has the most important qualities needed to complete the mission. He is a Peak True Immortal and has access to hellfire.
He would be the killing weapon, while Veydris would serve as the emergency sword, coming into play when the devourer least expects it.
Vexthra had studied their abilities, so she knew who to send and when.
"Remember, once the battle starts, the void will become fragile. This will make it hard to use, so aside from Ingrid, all of you should be careful when using it.
Also, when the Planet Devourer dies, there is a good chance the world will die with it, so be ready for anything. Of course, if you can end the battle much faster, that would also help."

"We will do our best, big sister," Ingrid said, taking out a spear from her space ring. She chose not to use her soul weapon since this mission is unpredictable, and the last thing she wanted was to injure her soul.
Zareth also retrieved a weapon that looked like a spear but curved at the tip. It was an innate weapon he had awakened recently, so this would be his first time using it.
The others also got ready to leave.
This mission is critical, so the least they could do is get it done as fast as possible.
"Good luck."
Vexthra had already located the planet’s core, so they knew where to go. It would take them a couple of hours to get there, so they left in a hurry.
